name: Prodelight Co.,Ltd.
summary: Prodelight Co.,Ltd. supplies cloud PBX phone systems and voice transmission services in Japan, planning, developing and selling cloud voice systems alongside offline services and audio devices. Its products include INNOVERA, IP-Line, Yealink terminals, MAXHUB electronic boards for meetings and classes, and INNOVERA Hikari. It is based in Osaka and was incorporated in 2008.
